fact: Ghana News Agency quotes Ghana Revenue Authority customs officials saying the Publican AI tool, which analyses importer, bank transfer, trade document and customs history data and presents risk indicators to officers on valuation, classification and origin, was piloted in February and fully deployed on 12 March 2026.

The Ministry of Finance and Ghana Revenue Authority said Publican Trade Solution, an AI-based tool helping customs officers value and classify imports, was fully rolled out at ports of entry on 11 March 2026 beside ICUMS.

The Ministry of Finance said that since its introduction on 11 March 2026 Publican Trade Solution had endorsed clearing of 75.3 percent of customs declarations and flagged 24.7 percent as below accepted global values.

Deputy Finance Minister Thomas Ampem Nyarko said a November 2025 pilot of the Publican AI digital inspection tool flagged anomalies in 18 of 43 test transactions and recovered GHS15 million from five companies, with nationwide rollout beside ICUMS due from 1 February 2026.
